content: 1. Nafcillin: Nafcillin reduces the plasma concentration and efficacy of fostemsavir by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Co-administration is contraindicated as it may lead to a loss of virologic response and resistance. 2. Nilotinib: Both nilotinib and fostemsavir prolong the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor closely. QTc prolongation has been reported with fostemsavir at doses exceeding the recommended levels. 3. Nitrofurantoin: Fostemsavir increases the levels or effects of nitrofurantoin by inhibiting BCRP transporters. Therapy modification or close monitoring is advised. Avoid co-administration or adjust the dose of BCRP substrates when used with fostemsavir. 4. Nortriptyline: Both nortriptyline and fostemsavir prolong the QTc interval. Use caution and monitor closely. QTc prolongation has been observed with higher-than-recommended doses of fostemsavir. 5. Ofloxacin: Ofloxacin and fostemsavir both increase the QTc interval. Exercise caution and monitor closely. QTc prolongation has been reported with excessive doses of fostemsavir. 6.
